international.title: Two charged after man was run over by van after flags incident in Midlands
international.summary: Pair due to appear in court in December in relation to incident that took place in May in south-west Birmingham Two men have been charged following an incident in Birmingham, where a man was run over by a van after flags were removed from lamp-posts. A man, in his 30s, was taken to hospital with leg injuries after the incident on Mayfield Road in the suburb of Stirchley, south-west Birmingham, on 14 May. Continue reading...
